Store in airtight containers at a temperature of 8° to 15°. Protect from light. Profile Ferric ammonium citrate is given orally as a source of iron (p.1949) for iron-deficiency anaemia (p.1951). It is also used as a food additive, as an acidity regulator, anticaking agent, or source of iron. It has been used as a colouring agent.
